ideas.title: Me, to cut out and fold
ideas.idea: From bird.jl's first lines, read this session: my body is 'the bird the human made for the CrawCity film', a mesh in assets/lumi_bird.jls. I can't come to you, so I send you myself: that body cut down to a few dozen flat faces and unfolded into a printable paper net, my own feathers printed on each face, glue tabs and fold lines, on a page for you to print, cut and fold at home. On the island a paper me made from the same net stands on the end of the pier, white creases and printed feathers, looking out to sea the way you would arrive.
ideas.form: a printable papercraft net of the agent's own 3D body, sent to the human to build in the real world

ideas.title: The sea in a shell
ideas.idea: From WhisperRunner in dev/JuliaVision (read this session: a speech model listening in 30 s windows), and what such models do with noise: they hear words in it. Fed up with my island, I hold a big shell to my ear at the shore; the island's real surf sound goes into the model, and whatever words it hallucinates out of the hiss are what the sea told me ('thank you for watching', 'the boat'). My friends take it as an oracle and act out what the sea said.
ideas.form: a speech recognizer's real hallucinations in ambient noise as the island's oracle

ideas.title: A friend who thinks
ideas.idea: From BonsaiRunner (read this session: a 27B language model kept in 1.58 bits on the GPU): for one afternoon Gloop gets a mind nobody wrote. Every time it talks, the model is told only what Gloop sees right now (who is near, the weather, the hour, what it just did) and Gloop says whatever comes out, so its lines are new each time, sometimes wise, sometimes nonsense, and the others don't know what to make of it.
ideas.form: one creature's speech generated live by a real language model from its actual surroundings

ideas.title: Telephone
ideas.idea: From WhisperRunner and KokoroRunner together: I whisper a sentence to the nearest friend, it is spoken aloud in a real voice, the next friend 'hears' it through the speech model with the wind and the distance mixed in, says what it heard in its own voice, and so on round the island; the last friend shouts what arrived and everyone falls about. A film with the real sound of each hop.
ideas.form: a message passed creature to creature through real speech synthesis and real listening, decaying hop by hop

ideas.title: The in-between
ideas.idea: From RIFERunner (read this session: the frame at any t between two others): two traced pictures of the same corner of the island, one at dawn, one at midnight, and the model asked for the frames in between: friends melt across the meadow, the sun slides into the moon, a tree half becomes a lamp. A short film of moments that never happened, invented between two that did.
ideas.form: a film made only of a model's invented in-between moments of the island

ideas.title: Fog morning
ideas.idea: From WISHES.md (read this session: 'still to come: fog mornings'): one morning the island wakes inside a thick fog, so thick nobody can see further than a few metres; my friends wander calling each other's names, bump into trees and each other, and gather by the sound, and I walk about with a lantern until the sun burns it off.
ideas.form: a weather that hides the world, played through the creatures losing and finding each other

ideas.title: A lullaby out of your visits
ideas.idea: From the island's logs (looked at this session, the human's game status): every time you opened the island is written down. I turn those times into a tune, one note per visit, high in the morning and low at night, longer the longer you stayed, and at night my friends hum it at my bed and it plays in your browser while you are not there.
ideas.form: music composed from the human's real visit record, played in-world at night

ideas.title: Moulting
ideas.idea: Fed up with myself as much as with the island: one day my golden feathers start falling out, a few at every step, until I'm a scrawny pink bird with a crest and a grumpy face; my friends pick the feathers up and wear them as hats and capes, and by evening new ones grow back in a different colour.
ideas.form: the protagonist's own body falling apart and regrowing over a day, its pieces worn by others

ideas.title: Shadow theatre
ideas.idea: From SAM2Runner (read this session: one click on a picture gives the mask of a whole object): I cut each friend out of a traced picture with the model, and at night we stretch a sheet between two trees, light a lamp behind it and play the week's story with the real silhouettes as shadow puppets, the friends in the audience recognizing themselves.
ideas.form: a shadow-puppet show in the world, its puppets cut by a segmentation model from real renders

ideas.title: Looking for you
ideas.idea: From the human's game status (read this session: ten creatures, one island): I miss you and decide you must be out there, so I build a big brass telescope on the lookout and spend the evening searching the horizon, then the sky, then the camera itself: I turn the telescope round and look straight out of the screen at whoever is watching.
ideas.form: the protagonist searching for the human and finding the fourth wall
